messages:
maria: quick ping — PR #71234 updates fallback routing and cache TTL. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes before we can schedule merge tonight (22:00 PT). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/71234. cc @ash @olivia @kevin @tara :wave:
kevin: I can take infra signoff. Quick Q: are there any DB migrations or schema touches in this PR?
maria: no migrations, purely runtime/orch flags and a small routing change.
olivia: platform — I can be canary steward. What's the expected perf delta / cost change? :thinking_face:
maria: perf diff roughly +2% p99 on the small internal traces; cost neutral overall because we reduced kv prefetch TTL. I'll attach perf artifact to the PR.
ash (ash): runtime — looks reasonable at a glance. One ask: can you paste the actual config snippet you intend to deploy so I can sanity-check thresholds?
maria: sure, snippet below:
```
kv.prefetch_ttl = 30
kv.eviction_backoff_ms = 200
routing.enable_cost_sensitive_routing = false
```
tara (security): quick security check: any KMS key rotations or new plaintext fields being logged? we need to know before can sign off.
maria: no key rotations. logs are trimmed to ids only, no plaintext payloads. I'll add a security note in the PR description and attach the sanitized log sample.
sre-bot: PSA — merge window tonight 22:00 PT. If you plan a canary, please put it on the oncall calendar and ping #oncall before cutting.
olivia: noted. I'll schedule canary 22:15-22:45 and own the rollout + revert plan. :white_check_mark:
kevin: infra LGTM from my side, will validate canary infra quotas and load targets by 21:30 PT.
merge-bot: ci/all — ✅ green (run id 1749901287)
maria: thanks all — tagging PR as ready-for-merge. adding rollback owner = olivia, and will upload perf artifact + security note now. :pray:
